summary: Akamai Technologies filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 18, 2026 it entered into Project Plan 2 and Project Plan 3 under its existing May 5, 2026 Master Services Agreement with Anthropic, PBC. Anthropic committed roughly $11.6 billion in aggregate payments for dedicated cloud computing capacity and managed support, with each plan carrying a seven-year initial term from its service start date. Termination rights cover uncured breach, insolvency, material outage, and change of control favoring an Anthropic competitor; unaffected plans survive as separate agreements. This is a commercial customer contract, not a special situation.
